title: Dashboard design roundup
summary: A batch of design changes landed across the Frigade Assistant dashboard over the last two weeks. The common thread is reading less and finding things faster.
body_markdown:
A batch of design changes landed across the Frigade Assistant dashboard over the last two weeks. The common thread is reading less and finding things faster.


**Wide monitors.** The dashboard now works on large and ultrawide screens. Reading pages keep a readable width and center themselves, while dense tables use the room.


**Sources.** The


[Sources page](https://app.frigade.ai/sources) groups everything Frigade Assistant learns from into three sections: Product agents, Knowledge agents, and Uploaded files. Each source has its own details page showing what it holds and how it feeds your assistant.


**Customization.** The Customization page was reworked with more customization options and a cleaner layout. The live preview runs beside the settings and follows the field you are editing, so you see the button, the input, a conversation, or the Assist API guide card as you change it.
